heading: Common questions
intro: Don't see yours? Call us and we'll answer it directly.

items.question: What services do you provide?
items.answer: Concrete, fencing, gates, demolition, land clearing, tree work and landscaping. We handle residential and commercial projects, big or small.

items.question: Is your company certified?
items.answer: Yes. We are a certified WBE, SBE and DBE construction company.

items.question: Do you offer free estimates?
items.answer: Absolutely. Estimates are free and carry no obligation, so you know the cost before we start.

items.question: What areas do you serve?
items.answer: Houston, Texas and the surrounding areas. We also take on larger municipal and commercial projects across Texas.

items.question: How soon can you start my project?
items.answer: Start times depend on the scope and our schedule, but we aim to begin promptly once the estimate is approved and contracts are signed.

items.question: Do you handle permits?
items.answer: We guide clients on permit requirements. For larger projects we often coordinate with municipalities to make sure the work is compliant.

items.question: Do you take both residential and commercial work?
items.answer: Yes, from backyard fencing and driveways to large-scale concrete and demolition.
